title: Small Business Support Grant Bondi Beach December 2025 – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the Small Business Support Grant for Bondi Beach in December 2025.
who_can_apply: Must be located and operating in the identified Impacted Area at the time of the Terrorist Attack.
Must have suffered Business Disruption as a result of the Terrorist Attack.
Must have a valid and active ABN as on 14 December 2025.
Must employ less than the equivalent of 20 full-time employees.
If the business owns the property, specific evidence is required.
If the business leases the property, specific evidence is required.
If the business operates multiple distinct Small Businesses under one ABN, each can apply for assistance up to $25,000, provided each meets the criteria.
what_you_need: Evidence of the business's ownership or lease of the property.
Evidence of financial impact of the event.
Evidence of employee numbers (e.g., payroll summaries or Single Touch Payroll records).
If the business owns the property, the applicant must provide specific documentation.
If the business leases the property, the applicant must provide specific documentation.

faqs.a: Funds of $5,000 are available to eligible applicants with specific evidence. Funds between $5,001 and $25,000 are available to eligible applicants with additional evidence.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the grant?
faqs.a: To be eligible, the business must be a Small Business, located and operating in the Impacted Area at the time of the Terrorist Attack, have suffered Business Disruption, and have a valid ABN as of 14 December 2025. The business must also employ less than the equivalent of 20 full-time employees.

faqs.q: What evidence do I need to provide?
faqs.a: Evidence requirements vary depending on whether the business owns or leases the property. If documents cannot be provided, the business may submit at least two documents from different categories as evidence of location within the Impacted Area.
